findings.current: Hyuk Mujin clicked his tongue with an expression that said *of course*, then pulled the two bamboo slips I had received earlier from inside his robe.
findings.defect: The direction of the earlier transfer is reversed. Hyuk Mujin had received the slips from the narrator, not the other way around.
findings.rationale: 내게 넘겨받은 describes Hyuk Mujin receiving the slips from the narrator; the current wording instead says the narrator received them.
findings.replacement: Hyuk Mujin clicked his tongue with an expression that said *of course*, then pulled the two bamboo slips I had handed him earlier from inside his robe.
findings.source: 그럼 그렇지, 하는 표정으로 혀를 찬 혁무진이 아까 내게 넘겨받은 죽간 두 개를 품에서 꺼냈다.

findings.current: A Supreme Peak master was someone capable of reversing an unfavorable battlefield in an instant. Choosing one was only natural if we wanted to stop the flames of war spreading in every direction.
findings.defect: “Choosing one” misstates the strategic mechanism. The context is dispersing or deploying Supreme Peak masters across multiple fronts, not selecting a single master.
findings.rationale: The following fire-truck analogy and Mae Jonghak’s separation of Taekyung and Cheongpung establish that the choice is to distribute such forces among the spreading conflicts.
findings.replacement: A Supreme Peak master could reverse a losing battle in an instant. With the flames of war spreading in every direction, deploying them where they were needed was only natural.
findings.source: 초절정 고수는 불리한 전황을 단번에 뒤집을 수 있는 존재. 사방으로 번지는 전화(戰火)의 불길을 막기 위해서는 당연한 선택이었다.

findings.current: After thinking it over, I swallowed a hollow breath.
findings.defect: “Swallowed a hollow breath” is an unnatural literal rendering and does not clearly convey his startled realization.
findings.rationale: 헛숨을 삼켰다 describes an involuntary breath or gasp prompted by sudden realization, not literally swallowing a hollow breath.
findings.replacement: After thinking it over, I sucked in a startled breath.
findings.source: 이유라. 곰곰이 생각하던 나는 헛숨을 삼켰다.

findings.current: “You’re a ghost, aren’t you? I haven’t even told you yet.”
findings.defect: The literal “ghost” is opaque in English and obscures the conversational sense that Jeok Cheongang has uncannily read his mind.
findings.rationale: 귀신이다 is used idiomatically here to marvel at Jeok Cheongang’s uncanny perceptiveness, not to identify him as a ghost.
findings.replacement: “You’re psychic. I haven’t even told you yet.”

findings.current: “Why do you look like you’ve swallowed a turd?”
findings.defect: The draft changes the crude physical image from chewing shit to swallowing a turd.
findings.rationale: 똥 씹은 얼굴 literally invokes the expression of someone chewing shit; retaining that image preserves the source’s blunt humor.
findings.replacement: “Why do you look like you’ve been chewing shit?”
findings.source: 네놈은 왜 그렇게 똥 씹은 얼굴을 하고 있느냐?

findings.current: Jeok Cheongang had been hovering between life and death at the time, so he had never personally experienced the two of them. But after waking up, he had heard everything that happened in the meantime, so he had no trouble understanding.
findings.defect: “Experienced the two of them” is unnatural and gives 겪다 an inappropriate experiential sense when it means personally encountering or dealing with them.
findings.rationale: 두 사람을 직접 겪어 본 적이 없지만 refers to Jeok Cheongang not having personally encountered the two people, while the latter clause explains why he can still understand the assessment.
findings.replacement: Jeok Cheongang had been hovering between life and death at the time, so he had never met either of them in person. But after waking up, he had heard everything that had happened, so he had no trouble following the discussion.
findings.source: 당시에 사경을 헤매고 있던 적천강은 두 사람을 직접 겪어 본 적이 없지만, 깨어난 후 그간 있었던 이야기를 모두 들은 터라 이해하는 데에는 별다른 무리가 없었다.

findings.defect: The profanity is softened relative to the strongly abusive but comic 개새끼야.
findings.rationale: 개새끼야 is stronger than “bastard”; the sharper English preserves Taekyung’s blunt register and the force of the joke.

summary: One reversed transfer action, one distorted deployment rationale, and several localized fidelity and voice issues.
